howto.what: Claude 每次读取、编辑文件或执行命令都会生成一条压缩的观察记录,并在会话结束时汇总。之后相关的记录会自动注入新的会话提示,下一次不用重新解释代码库。
howto.when: 在同一项目里进入第二个会话时,记忆注入开始生效;第一个会话只负责播种记忆。也可运行 /learn-codebase 一次性把整个仓库预先载入。

say.note: 会讲清观察记录、注入时机和数据位置。

say.text: 我的记忆数据存在哪里?会离开这台机器吗?
say.note: 说明本地目录,以及会调用 AI 服务商。
约 5 分钟,属于可选操作。

howto.what_en: Every Read, Edit and Bash Claude makes becomes a compressed observation; these are summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into later prompts so the next session starts with context.
howto.when_en: Memory injection begins on your second session in a project. The first session seeds memory; you can also run /learn-codebase to load a whole repo in one pass.

say_en.note: Covers capture, injection timing, and data location.

say_en.text: Where is my memory data stored? Does it leave this machine?
